[SWS_UCM_00157] Detection of reset
⌈
At start up
UCM
shall identify if uncontrolled
reset occurred.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00027)
The way for
UCM
to detect uncontrolled reset is project specific.
UCM
could use hard-
ware platform specific registers to detect Soft/Hard reset. Or it could access PHM
Functional Cluster to detect uncontrolled reset.
UCM
could also check that the
Cur-
rentStatus
persistent field is not
kIdle
or
kVerifying
.
